# NovaUI Component Library A collection of reusable UI elements designed to streamline development for SaaS applications. Built with a focus on consistency, accessibility, and scalability, this library provides ready-to-use patterns for buttons, modals, and form controls. Each component is crafted with modular architecture to adapt to diverse project needs while maintaining a cohesive visual language. ## Acknowledgments This project began as a personal initiative to standardize UI patterns across internal tools. Early feedback from colleagues helped refine the design system, ensuring it met both functional and aesthetic goals. Special thanks to the open-source community for foundational tools that enabled rapid prototyping and testing. ## Getting Started / Installation To use NovaUI, install it via npm: ```bash npm install @novaui/core ``` Import components directly into your project. For customization, refer to the `theme.config` file included in the package. ## Usage / Examples A basic modal component can be implemented as: ```html

This is a reusable modal.

``` Components are designed to work with minimal styling, allowing for easy integration into existing workflows. ## Tech Stack - HTML5 & CSS3 - JavaScript (ES6+) - Modular build tools for dependency management - Accessibility-focused development practices ## License Open source under the MIT License. See the `LICENSE` file for details. ## Badges [![Version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@novaui/core?color=blue)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@novaui/core) [![Dependencies](https://img.shields.io/npm/dependency-status/@novaui/core?color=green)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@novaui/core) [![License](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@novaui/core?color=orange)](LICENSE) ## Contributing Feedback and contributions are welcome. If you notice inconsistencies or have ideas for new components, open an issue or submit a pull request. Let’s build something useful together.
